# Fable 5 — ultracode

> A genuinely well-engineered static Pokédex: scripts/build-data.mjs compiles the entire PokéAPI surface into public/data ahead of time with a sha1-keyed on-disk fetch cache, 16-way concurrency, retry/backoff and 404-tolerance, and src/lib/api.ts is the only fetch site in the app, hitting nothing but /data/*. The compact positional move encoding plus vgIndex/methodIndex interning is what makes complete per-version-group learnsets for every variety affordable in ~8 KB brotli per species. The load-bearing logic is provably correct rather than plausibly correct — all 324 cells of the type matrix match the canonical Gen 6+ chart, defenseProfile propagates 0× immunities through both defending types with one shared implementation feeding detail/compare/team/typechart, evoTree renders real multi-branch evolutions with ~30 synthesized condition kinds, and the live index has exactly 1025 species with per-generation counts matching the official 151/100/135/107/156/72/88/96/120 split. The runtime smoke test is clean and reaches 1025/1025. Where it lands short of the top is depth per feature rather than breadth: the audit pass held eleven grades that were awarded as best-in-class against the fixed anchors and most did not survive — the browse grid, name search, single-key sort, artwork, shiny, flavor entries, compare, team builder, command palette, theming and responsiveness are all correct, complete, competent implementations with no distinguishing capability, which is the 2 anchor. The team builder specifically misses three of the five elements the rubric's own anchor enumerates (named multi-team storage, Showdown import/export, damage preview). Two derived-data figures on the flagship detail page are also wrong: format.ts:3-9 heightStr rounds inches without a foot carry, so 166 of 1025 species render impossible imperial heights like Charmander's '1′12″', and format.ts:23 catchPercent reports rate/255 under a '(X% at full HP)' label where the real full-HP figure is rate/765.

## Strengths

- Build pipeline: sha1-URL-keyed disk cache under .cache/pokeapi makes ~7,700 resource fetches resumable and re-runs free, with 4 attempts / 1-4-9s backoff, 30s AbortSignal.timeout, 404→null and a 16-way pool — real engineering, not a for-loop.
- Data correctness verified from the deployed artifacts, not trusted: 1025 unique species, zero rows where bst ≠ sum(stats), exact official per-generation counts, and a true 18×18 matrix whose 324 cells diff clean against the canonical Gen 6+ chart including every Fairy/Steel/Dark quirk.
- Complete per-variety data model — build-data.mjs:520-548 gives every form its own types, pastTypes, stats, abilities, dimensions, art, cry, held items and full learnset, and DetailPage re-drives nine panels off the selected chip.
- Crash-path discipline: every URL id integer-validated before use, csv params read defensively, resolveSpeciesKey → explicit 'No such Pokémon' state, ErrorBoundary re-keyed per pathname, Sprite onError fallback, localStorage stores shape-validated with try/catch on read and write, and exactly two non-null assertions repo-wide (both unreachable-safe). tsc --noEmit passes under strict.
- Keyboard and accessibility work that is real rather than decorative — roving-tabindex Arrow/Home/End over the type grid, arrow-key tablists, combobox/listbox contracts in three search surfaces, skip-link into a focusable <main>, aria-live readouts, and a prefers-reduced-motion reset.
- The team recruit engine (TeamPage.tsx:151-179), which scores all 1025 index rows by coverage-gap gain and rejects candidates that stack an existing ×4 weakness.

## Weaknesses

- Two wrong numbers on the most-visited page: heightStr's missing foot carry produces impossible imperial heights for 166 of 1025 species (Charmander '1′12″'), and catchPercent's rate/255 is presented as '% at full HP' where the correct value is rate/765 — Bulbasaur is overstated 3× as 17.6% vs 5.9%.
- No HTTP caching story of its own: wrangler.jsonc is 8 lines with no _headers and no assets.headers, so even content-hashed /assets/*.js and deploy-immutable /data/*.json are served max-age=0, must-revalidate. No service worker despite shipping a manifest, and no prefetch of prev/next shards despite arrow-key species stepping being a headline feature.
- Media is unowned — the build persists raw.githubusercontent.com URLs and PokeCard renders the 475px official-artwork PNG (mean ~132 KB) into a 96px box with no srcset and no thumbnail tier, even though the pipeline already wrote the small sprite URL into every shard.
- Dead payload and copy-paste: home/homeShiny/spriteShiny/spriteBack and spriteHistory[].backShiny are written into all 1025 shards and read nowhere; artUrl's shiny parameter is never passed by any of its four call sites; and HomePage re-implements rankSearch's id and fuzzy branches inline instead of importing the library six other files use.
- HomePage.tsx:105 skips sorting while a text query is active at the default sort, leaving the ↑/↓ direction button inert but still announcing a state change.
- The build's sanity guard fires at build-data.mjs:639, after every writeFile — it exits nonzero but truncated shards are already on disk and a later `npm run build` would ship them; `npm run data` is also not in the deploy path.
- Adapts to width only: no (hover: hover) / (pointer: coarse) queries anywhere, so the favorites star and card type accent are invisible on touch, and viewport-fit=cover ships with zero env(safe-area-inset-*).
- No pre-paint theme script — data-theme is set by initTheme() after the CSS and font imports, so light-theme users get a dark first paint.

## Standout

The build pipeline's compact learnset encoding: build-data.mjs interns version groups and learn methods into indices and stores each move as a positional [vg, method, level] triple, which is why a single ~78 KB / 7.9 KB-brotli species shard can carry all 17 Pikachu varieties with complete per-version-group learnsets and 17 sprite eras — and why MovesPanel can offer a real version-group + method-tab learnset browser per form with zero runtime API calls.

Against that: index.html:5 sets viewport-fit=cover with zero env(safe-area-inset-*) anywhere in src/, and the app adapts to width only — grep finds no (hover: hover), (pointer: coarse) or @container, so hover-gated affordances (favorites star, card type wash, detail.css:96, items.css:199, typechart.css:83) never appear on touch. Usable at phone widths = 2.` |
| Export / sharing | ◔ 1 | `Sharing exists only as clipboard copies of the current URL — TeamPage.tsx:192 copyShareLink and ComparePage.tsx:156 copyLink, both with success/failure feedback. No PNG/card export, no CSV/JSON download, no Showdown import or export anywhere in src/ (grep for showdown/toBlob/download returns nothing). Present but thin.` |

## Vendored source

The source in this directory is the code the model wrote, copied verbatim from [its repo](https://github.com/guitaripod/pokedex-fable-5-ultracode) minus `node_modules`, build output, and generated data.

> 23 MB of generated PokéAPI JSON (public/data, 2263 files) stripped from the vendored source; regenerate with `node scripts/build-data.mjs`.

Canonical history and issues live in the [original repo](https://github.com/guitaripod/pokedex-fable-5-ultracode). This is a scored snapshot for the benchmark.
